# 💬 Cybermes Community & Discussion Guidelines

Welcome to the **Cybermes Discussions** community! 👋

This is an open, collaborative space for offensive security researchers, bug bounty hunters, AI agent builders, and developers to share ideas, troubleshoot setups, discuss autonomous agent architectures, and showcase workflows.

---

## 🧭 Discussion Categories

Please choose the most appropriate category when creating a new discussion:

| Category | Icon | Purpose |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Q&A** | 💬 | Questions regarding setup, LLM configuration (OmniRoute / LM Studio / OpenRouter), Windows/Docker environments, and troubleshooting. |
| **Ideas** | 💡 | Feature requests, proposals for new security tools, AI skills, and architectural enhancements. |
| **Show and Tell** | 🚀 | Share your custom scripts, autonomous workflows, sanitized PoCs, benchmark results, and success stories. |
| **General** | 📢 | Open community chats, security news, offensive agent research, and general feedback. |
| **Announcements** | 📣 | Official updates, release highlights (v1.5.0+), and project roadmaps posted by maintainers. |

---

## 📜 Community Rules & Code of Conduct

To maintain a professional, ethical, and high-signal research environment, all participants must adhere to these rules:

### 1. 🛡️ Strict Ethical Standards & Responsible Research
- Cybermes is designed for **authorized penetration testing, defensive diagnostics, bug bounty programs, and educational research**.
- **Do NOT** request help with, share methodologies for, or discuss attacking unauthorized targets, systems, or organizations.

### 2. 🔒 Zero Sensitive Data & Sanitization Standard
- **NEVER** post live API keys, session tokens, passwords, Telegram bot tokens, or private credentials.
- **NEVER** publish real target domains, live customer infrastructure, or unredacted assessment data.
- Always sanitize data using RFC 2606 (`example.com`, `api.target.example.org`) and RFC 5737 (`198.51.100.x`, `127.0.0.1`).

### 3. 🎯 Signal-to-Noise & Search First
- Before starting a new discussion, use the search bar to check if your question or proposal has already been answered.
- Use clear, descriptive titles (e.g. `[Q&A] How to connect Cybermes with LM Studio on Windows 11` instead of `Help please`).
- Format code blocks, command outputs, and logs with appropriate Markdown syntax.

### 4. 🤝 Respectful & Constructive Collaboration
- Be welcoming, patient, and constructive. We welcome participants of all experience levels.
- Harassment, discriminatory language, spam, self-promotion of commercial services, and toxic behavior will result in immediate moderation and bans.
